name: Varada Sethu
biography: Varada Sethumadhavan (born 12 May 1992) is a Indian-born British actress. Her most notable credits include playing Detective Sergeant Mishal Ali in Hard Sun (2018), Lance Corporal Manisha Chetri in Strike Back: Vendetta (2020), Cinta Kaz in Andor (2022–2025), and Belinda Chandra in Doctor Who (2025).
